statement: Tian Yi Gui Ren (Heavenly Nobleman) — the most esteemed of the classical noble stars is traditionally read as unexpected help, mentors, and rescue from danger at critical moments, softening the effect of difficult placements elsewhere in the chart.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard BaZi literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
